description: Na₄Mg(Mo₂O₅)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.75 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.83 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.47 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.75 Å. Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MgO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MoO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MoO₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent MoO₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one MoO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 63°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.32 Å. There are four inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded to six O atoms to form MoO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent MoO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one MoO₄ trigonal pyramid, and  a faceface with one MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-63°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.23 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded to six O atoms to form MoO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent MoO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one MoO₄ trigonal pyramid, and edges with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-42°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.17 Å. In the third Mo site, Mo is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.85-2.20 Å. In the fourth Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted MoO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra and corners with two MoO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-64°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.15 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and two Mo atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and two Mo atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na and two Mo atoms to form ONa₂Mo₂ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃MgMo₂ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Mo₂ square pyramid,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂MgMo₂ trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂MgMo₂ trigonal bipyramid, and  a faceface with one ONa₃MgMo₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 85°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and two Mo atoms to form distorted ONa₃MgMo₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃Mo₂ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent ONa₂MgMo₂ trigonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂Mo₂ trigonal pyramid,  a faceface with one ONa₂MgMo₂ trigonal bipyramid, and  a faceface with one ONa₂Mo₂ trigonal pyramid. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and two Mo atoms to form ONa₂MgMo₂ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Mo₂ square pyramid,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂MgMo₂ trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Mo₂ square pyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂MgMo₂ trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Mo₂ trigonal pyramid, and  a faceface with one ONa₃MgMo₂ octahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two Mo atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Mg and two Mo atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Mo atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to three Na and two Mo atoms to form distorted ONa₃Mo₂ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃MgMo₂ octahedra, corners with four ONa₂MgMo₂ trigonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂Mo₂ trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂MgMo₂ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-58°. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and two Mo atoms to form distorted ONa₂MgMo₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃MgMo₂ octahedra, corners with three equivalent ONa₃Mo₂ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂MgMo₂ trigonal bipyramid,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂Mo₂ trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂MgMo₂ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-56°.
